respuesta.razonamiento: The architecture represents a Rendering-as-a-Service (RAS) platform on AWS using Spot EC2 instances, SQS queues, and serverless orchestration. All 12 visual boxes correspond to the narration components: user mobile/web clients, CloudFront, API Gateway, S3, Step Functions, CloudWatch, two SQS queues (requests and responses), an EC2 Auto Scaling group of Spot rendering instances, and three distinct Lambda functions (frontend service, termination handler, and autoscaler). All 19 drawn lines are reconciled into 4 logical workflows: request submission and response polling, video rendering and playback delivery via S3/CloudFront, spot instance termination mitigation via CloudWatch events, and periodic custom autoscaling managed by Step Functions.
respuesta.nombre: Rendering as a Service with EC2 Spot and Serverless
